measurements.notes: Hanover County Board of Supervisors approved the 1,200-acre Tract rezoning UNANIMOUSLY on 27 Mar 2024, after a unanimous Planning Commission recommendation in January. A unanimous vote is the strongest available signal of local political appetite.

Required discretionary rezoning, which carries political risk in principle — but it passed unanimously at both commission and board, so the pathway was routine in practice for this jurisdiction at that time.

Actual transaction: $33M for 1,200 acres (May 2024) = ~$27,500/ha. This is a real arms-length sale price post-entitlement, not a comparable — unusually good evidence for this factor, though still Tier C since it was read from press coverage rather than a parsed deed record.

US domestic deployment. Advanced accelerators may be installed and operated at a US site without export licensing; the controls govern export and re-export, not domestic use. Rule set checked 2026-09-03 — this is the fastest-moving input in the framework and must be re-verified per analysis.

gates.name: Credible power path to target load
gates.reason: Substation available capacity is unknown — the most common cause of late-stage project failure. Verify with the utility before committing capital.
gates.remediation_hint: Evaluate behind-the-meter generation, or shift target year, or reduce target load.

gates.name: Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture
gates.reason: Water availability and rights both unmeasured.
gates.remediation_hint: Switch to air-cooled or closed-loop (costs 10-30% more power), or secure reclaimed water.

gates.name: Flood exclusion
gates.reason: Outside the 500-year floodplain (modeled return period 1000 yr).
gates.remediation_hint: Site the pad outside the mapped zone, or commission a local flood study — global datasets are coarse.

gates.name: Sufficient contiguous developable land
gates.reason: 2592 ha contiguous developable area (computed upper bound).
gates.remediation_hint: Expand the AOI, consider adjacent parcel assembly, or re-profile to a smaller build.

gates.name: Entitlement path exists
gates.reason: Requires discretionary rezoning (rezoning_routine) — this converts an engineering problem into a political one.
gates.remediation_hint: Pre-application meeting with planning staff; budget 9-24 months and community engagement.

gates.name: Protected area exclusion
gates.remediation_hint: Reconfigure the site boundary to avoid overlap entirely — mitigation pathways are slow and uncertain.

gates.name: No active data center moratorium
gates.remediation_hint: Verify moratorium scope and expiry; some exempt by-right industrial zones or cap by megawatt.

gates.name: Intended compute is legally deployable
gates.remediation_hint: Re-profile to domestically-available accelerators, or evaluate license pathway with counsel.
